name: exchange_rates_corrected
sql: SELECT rate_date::text,source_date::text,base_currency,quote_currency,rate::text,provider,fallback_type FROM meta_ads.exchange_rates WHERE rate_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' ORDER BY rate_date

name: naver_cost_coverage_infinity
sql: SELECT o.payload->>'paymentDate' AS date,count(*) AS sale_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId','') IS NULL) AS unmapped_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId','') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_unit_cost_settings c WHERE c.payload->>'storeId'=o.payload->>'storeId' AND c.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId'=o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_unit_cost_snapshot_entries e WHERE e.payload->>'storeId'=o.payload->>'storeId' AND e.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId'=o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId')) AS no_cost_anywhere FROM public.order_items o WHERE o.payload->>'storeId'='5ba1d3cf-7aee-4cd1-aecd-d44352f665dd' AND o.payload->>'paymentDate'>='2026-10-20' AND o.payload->>'paymentDate'<'2026-10-27' AND o.payload->>'saleStatus'='SALE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: naver_cost_coverage_patima
sql: SELECT o.payload->>'paymentDate' AS date,count(*) AS sale_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId','') IS NULL) AS unmapped_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId','') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_unit_cost_settings c WHERE c.payload->>'storeId'=o.payload->>'storeId' AND c.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId'=o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_unit_cost_snapshot_entries e WHERE e.payload->>'storeId'=o.payload->>'storeId' AND e.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId'=o.payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId')) AS no_cost_anywhere FROM public.order_items o WHERE o.payload->>'storeId'='78f8cb08-ffe3-481a-94d7-be87ae93ed79' AND o.payload->>'paymentDate'>='2026-10-20' AND o.payload->>'paymentDate'<'2026-10-27' AND o.payload->>'saleStatus'='SALE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: naver_stored_daily_recent
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'date' AS date,payload->>'calculationVersion' AS calculation_version,payload->>'calculatedAt' AS calculated_at,payload->>'totalRevenue' AS total_revenue,payload->>'netProfit' AS net_profit,payload->>'costSnapshotId' AS cost_snapshot_id,payload->>'mappingBasisHash' AS mapping_basis_hash FROM public.daily_store_summaries WHERE payload->>'date'>='2026-10-20' AND payload->>'date'<'2026-10-27' ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 30

name: legacy_connection_counts
sql: SELECT 'META_ADSET' AS source_kind,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE connection_id IS NULL) AS unbound FROM meta_ads.meta_adset_daily_metrics WHERE is_current AND metric_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' UNION ALL SELECT 'CAFE24_ORDER',count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE connection_id IS NULL) FROM meta_ads.cafe24_order_lines WHERE is_current AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26'
